=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:445-477 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_checks_completed` caches nothing, so the new `GET user` read at line 477 (and, per minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, the commit-statuses read at line 445/443) runs again on every poll of `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (lines 878-912) whenever a failed `review / gate` is superseded while other CI is still pending, even though the token's login cannot change within one process.
  WHY: With the defaults AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_WAIT_MINUTES=45 and AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_POLL_SECONDS=60, one merge wait can make about 45 extra user reads (about 90 calls counting the statuses reads) against the shared GH_PAT budget behind the PR #9168 rate-limit failure; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the `gh_retry` give-up (exit 75) could fail the merge step again. The result stays correct (fail-closed). All four reviewers rated it SEVERITY: NIT, mapped here to low; there was no severity disagreement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_checks_completed, line 477: gate_sup_self_login="$(gh_retry _safe_gh_jq user 2>/dev/null | jq -r ...)". It is called from the _pr_wait_for_required_checks poll loop, lines 893-912 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Nothing caches the GET user read, so it runs again on every poll that reaches the superseded branch while a CI run is pending (every 60s, up to 45 min), and each pass also repeats the statuses read.
  WHY: The result stays correct, but it costs up to about 45 extra core-bucket calls per merge wait on the shared GH_PAT, the budget whose exhaustion caused the PR #9168 failure. In the #9168 shape the read happens once in practice.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, _pr_checks_completed, the superseded$'\t'*) branch around line 477: cache the login in a new global (for example PR_CHECKS_GATE_SUP_SELF_LOGIN_CACHE), set only when it matches the login regex, so a failed read still gives creator_check_failed; estimated lines changed: 4; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_pr_checks_completed`, the new `gate_sup_self_login="$(gh_retry _safe_gh_jq user 2>/dev/null | ...)"` read inside the `superseded$'\t'*)` case branch, called from `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` poll loop | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Each poll iteration runs the conditional statuses read and the new `GET user` call again, with no caching: about 45 + 45 (≈90) extra API calls per merge wait.
  WHY: This is a cost issue, not a correctness one. On a contended merge wait, the calls the relaxation adds can block it again under the rate limit that caused PR #9168.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION 1: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, `_pr_checks_completed`, `superseded$'\t'*)` branch (around line 477): cache the validated login in `PR_CHECKS_GATE_SUP_LOGIN_CACHE`, set only on a match of `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*(\[bot\])?$`; caching the statuses read at line 443 is out of scope; estimated lines changed: 4; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:477; `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` calls `_pr_checks_completed` inside its polling loop at lines 878-894 and continues polling while CI is pending at lines 905-912 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `GET user` lookup repeats on every poll when a failed gate has a qualifying success status: roughly 45 extra user requests per merge wait, although the login does not change.
  WHY: It adds repeated GitHub API traffic to the same checks path linked to the reported rate-limit failure. The suggested fix is to cache a valid login for the process and retry only after a failed or invalid read.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_pr_checks_completed` lines 445 and 477, interacting with `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` lines 894 and 905-912 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The commit-statuses read (line 445) and the new `GET user` read (line 477) are issued again on every poll iteration while CI is pending, with no cache: about 45 extra user calls on top of about 45 statuses reads per default wait.
  WHY: Under rate pressure the `gh_retry` give-up (exit 75) can fail the merge step again. The outcome stays correct (fail-closed), so this is a cost regression the last run introduced, not a wrong-merge defect.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, `_pr_checks_completed`, `superseded$'\t'*)` branch (line 477): cache the first valid login in `PR_CHECKS_GATE_SUP_SELF_LOGIN_CACHE`, store it only on a regex match, so a failed read still yields `creator_check_failed`; estimated lines changed: 4; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
